mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM observation o JOIN capability_invocation ci ON ci.id = o.capability_invocation_id WHERE o.id = #{observationId} AND o.investigation_id = #{investigationId} AND (ci.run_no = #{runNo} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM evidence e JOIN diagnosis_evidence_ref r ON r.evidence_id = e.id JOIN diagnosis d ON d.id = r.diagnosis_id WHERE e.observation_id = o.id AND d.investigation_id = #{investigationId}))
